proposed_template.amplitude_status: Research design choices, not inferred field ranges; subject to unchanged BESS limits and healthy admission

protocol_requirements: Nominal P/Q demand must be distinguished from voltage-dependent actual electrical load
AI and industrial labels must give identical responses for identical nominal P/Q, dynamic load law, supply-chain state, network and controls
Every new waveform requires a no-fault loss-compensated safe continuous orbit before fault claims
Controller receives only current measurements and causal history; phase/stage indexes remain offline
No per-phase or per-cycle resets of source, DC energy, integrators, delays, or SoC
Internal buffers, if modeled, require bounded power and energy accounting; no free UPS reserve
No binary raw-data reproducibility or facility FRT validation claim in this audit
